scope: Developer-authored offline and real ORCA regression; user explicitly excludes real LLM tests
source_rule: Snapshot all src files and selected tests before/after each command; changes invalidate a stable-source claim
backend: existing frozen linux-container, original shared environment lease

orca_matrix.expected: one real illegal-input failure, one corrected HCN NMR completion; three shielding tensors; same logical identity, original attempt and Request retained
PBE0/def2-SVP real stdout parsed by task code; five actual transition rows
HF/def2-SVP original and 37 degree rotated geometry; max tensor covariance error <1e-3 au, isotropic difference <1e-4 au
six RDKit candidates; actual conformer IDs; two HF/STO-3G single points; four excluded explicitly by probe scope

retry_rule: No automatic pytest rerun; diagnose and record every failed probe before bounded additional verification. Never hide previously consumed starts.
qualification: All generated observations remain unverified; no task-wide scientific or autonomous success claim
offline_boundary: pytest default denies external sockets and scientific processes; scripted model transports are local test doubles
orca_boundary: Only --live-orca --live-container; model profile disabled, model permission false, model call/token budgets zero; child model API keys removed and pytest network blocked
limitations: Not the seven formal tasks and not new hidden-task generalization evidence
Identity resolution failure remains unqualified; developer registered geometries do not prove identity lookup repair
Costs are measured lower bounds and there is no per-Attempt disk hard quota
Final-purpose switching covers call and decision-round exhaustion; token/time limits retain conservative existing guards
